about: Owner decisions for docs/DMF-UI-SHADCN-PARITY.json. Each key is an item id from that record (an id ending in * covers every id with that prefix) and each value is the reason the difference is intentional. A decision that no longer matches a difference fails `npm run shadcn:check`.

button.variants.size:md: Kept as an alias of default for existing consumers (DMF-UI-NOVA.md).
button.props.Button.as: Astro polymorphism: DMF UI renders <a> or <button> through `as` (and `href`) instead of Base UI's `render` prop.
